title: Floral lace chain trim
excerpt: A continuous strip of small crochet flowers joined by chain arcs in lace weight yarn. Each flower has 5 petals and the chain gives the trim a relaxed drape.
sourceNotes: An edging made as a chain of 5-petal flower motifs linked by single chains. Worked independently and then sewn onto a fabric edge.

glossaryTerms.definition: A small 5-petal flower motif worked in the round from a magic ring, with each petal formed by a chain-3 arc and a double crochet.
A short chain of 6 worked between two flower motifs to connect them while maintaining a flexible drape in the finished trim.

crochet.finishedSizeText: Trim strip to any length required, approx. 2.5 cm wide.

content.text: is joined to the previous flower by a
of 6 stitches, creating a flexible chain of blooms.

Magic ring. Round 1: ch 1, 10 dc into ring, join. Round 2: *ch 3, skip 1 dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * 5 times (5 petal arcs). Round 3: work 1 dc, 3 tr, 1 dc into each arc (5 petals). Fasten off leaving a 15 cm tail.

For each new flower, chain 6 and attach to the base of the previous flower using a slip stitch. Then work the new flower in the round from a magic ring as above. Continue until the trim reaches the required length.
Use the tails and the tapestry needle to sew the bottom of each flower to the fabric edge, spacing evenly. Weave in all ends.
